trade_remedies_details.subject: Section 232 tariff on Automobiles and Autoparts

details.note: All imports of automobiles and automobile parts articles shall be subject to a 25% ad valorem tariff and shall continue in effect, unless such actions are expressly reduced, modified, or terminated.
The U.S. applies a 10% additional tariffs on all Products from the People's Republic of China to address the Synthetic Opioid Supply Chain.

The United States will continue to be suspended until 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on November 10, 2026. Covered imported products of China, including covered products of Hong Kong and Macau, that are entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption prior to 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on November 10, 2026 will continue be subject to a reciprocal tariff of 10% ad valorem in accordance with Executive Order 14257 of April 2, 2025 (Regulating Imports With a Reciprocal Tariff to Rectify Trade Practices That Contribute to Large and Persistent Annual United States Goods Trade Deficits), as amended. However, products and articles subject to Section 232 (Automobiles and Auto parts) are not subject to Reciprocal tariffs.

notifications.Title: Draft Amendments No. 2 to the Technical Regulation of the Eurasian Economic Union "On Safety of Packaged Potable Water Including Natural Mineral Water" (TR EAEU 044/2017)
notifications.Description: Draft Amendments No. 2 to TR EAEU 044/2017 - introduces a number of requirements for the labeling of natural mineral waters, natural and treated potable waters, and for confirming the compliance of labeling during the declaration or state registration of packaged potable waters, aiming to protect consumers from incomplete or unreliable information regarding the origin, safety, and properties of potable waters; - revises, based on many years of experience in using mineral potable waters, methods of their therapeutic and prophylactic application, toxicologicai studies, and taking into account the requirements of international, interstate, and national standards, the permissible levels of fluorides in natural mineral waters concerning table waters, manganese, and requirements for assessing radiation safety concerning therapeutic and therapeutic-table waters; - eliminates a number of editorial and technical inconsistencies.
notifications.HS code(s): 2201 - Waters, incl. natural or artificial mineral waters and aerated waters, not containing added sugar, other sweetening matter or flavoured; ice and snow
notifications.Objectives: Prevention of deceptive practices and consumer protection (TBT); Protection of human health or safety (TBT); Other (TBT)
notifications.Relevant documents: Draft Amendments No. 2 to the Technical Regulation of the Eurasian Economic Union "On Safety of Packaged Potable Water Including Natural Mineral Water" (TR EAEU 044/2017) https://regulation.eaeunion.org/pd/3290/Technical Regulation of the Eurasian Economic Union "On Safety of Packaged Potable Water Including Natural Mineral Water" (TR EAEU 044/2017) https://eec.eaeunion.org/comission/department/deptexreg/tr/tr_EAEU_044-2017.php

notifications.Title: Draft Decision of the Council of the Eurasian Economic Commission on Amendment to the List of Regulated Products (Consignments, Materials, Goods) Subject to Quarantine Phytosanitary Control (Surveillance) at the Customs Border of the Eurasian Economic Union and in the Customs Territory of the Eurasian Economic Union
notifications.Description: The draft Decision enables imports to, and transportation within the customs territory of  the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) of wood packaging and dunnage material without a phytosanitary certificate, if the goods indicated have been treated and marked in accordance with the Common Quarantine Phytosanitary Requirements for Regulated Products and Pests at the Customs Border and in the Customs Territory of the EAEU (approved by Decision of the Council of the Eurasian Economic Commission No. 157 of 30 November 2016).
notifications.Products covered: Wood packaging and dunnage material (HS code(s): of Chapter 44)
notifications.HS code(s): 44 - WOOD AND ARTICLES OF WOOD; WOOD CHARCOAL

notifications.Title: Draft Decision of the Council of the Eurasian Economic Commission on Amendments to the Common Quarantine Phytosanitary Requirements for Regulated Products and Pests at the Customs Border and in the Customs Territory of the EAEU
notifications.Description: The draft Decision withdraws the requirement for fresh or chilled tomatoes, peppers and aubergines (eggplants) to be free from Pepino mosaic virus (PepMV) as currently indicated in the Common Quarantine Phytosanitary Requirements for Regulated Products and Pests at the Customs Border and in the Customs Territory of the Eurasian Economic Union.

notifications.Title: Letter of the Federal Service for Veterinary and Phytosanitary Surveillance No. FS-ARe-7/6809-3 as of 12 November 2025
notifications.Description: This letter introduces temporary restrictions on the imports of products mentioned in point 3 to the Russian Federation, as well as on the transit of cattle, small cattle and animals susceptible to bluetongue through the territory of the Russian Federation from Japan due to the registration of bluetongue disease outbreaks.

notifications.Title: Letter of the Federal Service for Veterinary and Phytosanitary Surveillance as of 5 November 2025 No. FS-KS-7/21811
notifications.Description: This letter introduces temporary restrictions on the imports of live swine and products obtained thereof, hunting trophies and equipment to the Russian Federation, as well as on the transit of live swine through the territory of the Russian Federation from Chinese Taipei due to the registration of outbreaks of African swine fever (ASF) in Chinese Taipei.
notifications.Products covered: Live  swine;  meat  of  swine;  meat  and  edible  meat  offal;  swine embryos and boar semen; hunting trophies; maintenance, slaughter and processing equipment used (HS code(s): 0103; 0203; 020630; 020910; 0210; of 0502; of 0511; 1601*; 1602*; 843680; 843850; 970529)*  With  exception  of  prepared  heat-treated  goods  of  pork,  prepared  goods  containing  pork  or  raw materials  of  animal  origin  (from  pork)  for  the  production  of  feeds  for  non-productive  and  fur-producing animals with the use of technologies providing destruction of ASFV in accordance with the provisions of Chapter 15.1 of the OIE Terrestrial Animal Health Code.
notifications.HS code(s): 0103 - Live swine; 0203 - Meat of swine, fresh, chilled or frozen; 020630 - Fresh or chilled edible offal of swine; 020910 - Pig fat, free of lean meat, not rendered or otherwise extracted, fresh, chilled, frozen, salted, in brine, dried or smoked; 0210 - Meat and edible offal, salted, in brine, dried or smoked; edible flours and meals of meat or meat offal; 0502 - Pigs', hogs' or boars' bristles and hair; badger hair and other brush making hair; waste of such bristles or hair; 0511 - Animal products n.e.s.; dead animals of all types, unfit for human consumption; 1601 - Sausages and similar products, of meat, meat offal, blood or insects; food preparations based on these products.; 1602 - Prepared or preserved meat, meat offal, blood or insects (excl. sausages and similar products, and meat extracts and juices); 843680 - Agricultural, horticultural, forestry or bee-keeping machinery, n.e.s.; 843850 - Machinery for the industrial preparation of meat or poultry (excl. cooking and other heating appliances and refrigerating or freezing equipment); 970529 - Collections and collectors’ pieces of zoological, botanical, mineralogical, anatomical or paleontological interest (excl. human specimens and parts thereof, and extinct or endangered species and parts thereof)
